title: Equal-capacity periodic-gravity search on fresh GHASP photometry and two-sided H-alpha rotation curves
hypothesis: One universal periodic response, with wavelength and phase fixed by physical radius, a baryon-predicted orbital clock, logarithmic scale, or baryonic phase coupling, predicts fresh resolved galaxy rotation curves beyond smooth baryonic and ordinary structural controls.

discovery_policy.universal_gravity_track: Require one unchanged periodic family with a common wavelength and phase rule to beat baryonic and flexible smooth controls across held-out galaxies, both kinematic sides, radial halves, mass halves, surface-brightness halves, selection-aware nulls, and local limits.
discovery_policy.phenomenon_publication_track: Independently retain any reproducible common radial, clock, log-scale, or baryon-coupled periodic relation that beats the strongest ordinary controls on its measured domain, even if it is not gravity or does not solve missing mass.
discovery_policy.partial_result_track: Retain preregistered regime-specific periodic structure as a scoped replication hypothesis when it clears its frozen effect and null thresholds, without calling it universal or a paper result.

theory.response_rule: At every resolved radius, log10(v)=log10(v_baryonic calibrated on training galaxies)+A*s*W(g_bar)*E(r/h)*(sin(theta)+q2*sin(2*theta))/(2 ln 10), with one universal cell and no galaxy-specific periodic parameter.

niche_rules.baryonic_orbital_clock: theta=2*pi*t_bar_myr/T_myr+phi, where t_bar is computed only from radius and the frozen baryonic-light prediction

theory.local_limit: The same low-acceleration window is evaluated at one AU using Solar acceleration; admitted cells must remain below the frozen fractional-response bound.
theory.stability_limit: The multiplier is strictly positive and bounded on the frozen domain. These empirical acceleration laws are not claimed to possess a stable covariant action until one is derived.

external_constraints.label: Epinat et al., complete GHASP kinematic analysis
external_constraints.scope: Primary survey description and homogeneous two-dimensional H-alpha rotation-curve methodology.

external_constraints.label: Barbosa et al., GHASP Rc surface photometry
external_constraints.scope: Independent total-light, disk, bulge, bar, inclination, size, and surface-brightness predictors.

external_constraints.label: Boos, gravitational Friedel oscillations
external_constraints.scope: Known oscillatory gravitational behavior in linearized higher- and infinite-derivative gravity; spatial oscillations themselves are not historically new.

external_constraints.label: Calcagni and Kuroyanagi, log-periodic gravity signatures
external_constraints.scope: Known connection between logarithmic oscillations, discrete scale invariance, and beyond-Einstein gravity.

external_constraints.label: Burrage and Dombrowski, local time variation of G
external_constraints.scope: Local-measurement constraints and screening caveats for time-dependent gravitational couplings.

external_constraints.label: McGaugh, Lelli, and Schombert, radial acceleration relation
external_constraints.scope: Strong smooth baryon-acceleration comparator and warning that baryonic features can track rotation-curve features without periodic gravity.

prior_equivalence: A sinusoidal correction is a known mathematical basis and is not itself a new formula.
Spatial oscillations overlap known higher-derivative and nonlocal gravitational ripple families.
The Item 25 oscillatory cosmic-history equation is retained as an equivalence comparator but is not retuned here; GHASP has no useful redshift-history leverage.
Baryonic orbital-clock and phase-coupled forms are potentially distinct syntheses only, not evidence of historical novelty.
Spiral arms, bars, disk breaks, beam smearing, interpolation, asymmetric drift, and baryonic profile features are ordinary non-gravitational or standard-gravity explanations.
claim_limits: Rc light with a fixed stellar mass-to-light proxy omits resolved atomic, molecular, ionized-gas, remnant, and dust mass.
H-alpha traces ionized gas, not the speed of every star, and noncircular motions can enter both sides of a curve.
The exponential disk plus spherical Sersic bulge approximation is an intentionally fixed baryonic-light control, not a precision mass model.
A periodic residual may expose photometric structure, sampling, or instrument systematics rather than gravity.

A positive exploration result becomes at most a phenomenon lead; an unchanged independent replication is required before a paper claim, and later lensing, cluster, local, stability, and cosmology gates are required for a gravity claim.

observable_lineage.baryons: GHASP X Rc total light and response-blind disk/bulge/bar/decomposition geometry, converted with one fixed stellar mass-to-light proxy before curve access.
observable_lineage.response: Exploration-only GHASP VI/VII machine-readable two-sided H-alpha rotation-curve points, queried by already-frozen identity after both freezes.

sample.rule: Intersect response-blind GHASP photometry with curve identity-only listings, exclude every predecessor name and coordinate, enforce frozen photometric geometry and resolution cuts, split five stellar-mass strata, seal two HMAC-ranked identities per stratum, and assign all remaining identities to five folds before any curve value query.

candidate_generator.algorithm: numpy.random.Generator(PCG64) with four exactly balanced periodic niches before response-independent positivity, boundedness, nondegeneracy, cycle-span, and local filters
candidate_generator.synthetic_injection_rule: One exact target-blind, nondegenerate, material-strength admissible index per niche, frozen before response access.

evaluation.baseline_baryonic: training-only affine calibration of a fixed exponential Rc disk plus spherical Sersic bulge light model with one fixed stellar mass-to-light proxy
evaluation.baseline_flexible_nuisance: fixed ridge regression on smooth log baryonic speed, log radius, radius powers, log acceleration, mass, surface brightness, inclination, morphology, bulge fraction, bar, disk break, seeing resolution, and predeclared interactions, with no periodic basis
evaluation.primary_loss: galaxy-folded out-of-fold MSE of log10 side-averaged H-alpha rotation speed on six frozen disk-scaled radii
